title: The Listening Harvest
author: Freya Marchetti
blurb: Beatrix Lockridge, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
